inference.finite_transfer_matrix: A finite positive transfer gap is internally computable but carries no continuum authority.
inference.finite_volume_gap_collapse: Positive finite-volume gaps can decrease to zero; volume-uniformity is required.
inference.hidden_gapless_direct_sum: A positive visible-sector gap can coexist with a hidden zero-energy sector, so the finite alpha=1 carrier cannot certify the full gap.
inference.noncommuting_limit_order: Cutoff and volume limits can disagree, so their interchange needs a theorem.
inference.regulated_4d_lattice: A well-formed cutoff/volume fixture does not prove a continuum limit or uniform gap.
